items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: Curly McDimple is mentioned as the title of a play/show ('in the story of the play, Curly McDimple', 'the show was called... Curly McDimple') and not as a person with whom the interviewee had a personal or professional relationship.

ctx.x: Chuck and Chuckles. Well, he was pinch-hitting for a vacation -- a very dear friend of his, one of the brothers of the Hillman Brothers, you see and Chris's brother. His name was George, you know. George Hillman. And he was playing Bill Bojangles Robinson, you see. But he was only playing Bill and Curly McDimple, you see.
So, he had a -- I think he had a two week vacation coming up, you know. So, he wanted someone to -- that could do script, you understand --
